text:
Situation: Doxorubicin hydrochloride 2 mg/mL 10 mL vials are not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 105 vials (33.1 days on hand at 3.2 vials per day). Corvale General holds 65 vials (23.2 days on hand at 2.8 vials per day).

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show doxorubicin hydrochloride is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately one month at both sites. No FDA shortage declaration exists. Proactive purchasing from available suppliers is warranted to maintain supply continuity.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC as primary source; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Baxter Healthcare Corporation as secondary source; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Buyer to qualify Gland Pharma Limited as tertiary source; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
4. Buyer to evaluate Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. and Sagent Pharmaceuticals for additional depth; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
5. Buyer to report weekly inventory levels to P&T Committee until both sites exceed 60 days on hand; requires P&T Chair acknowledgment.

Not recommended: Allocation restrictions, therapeutic substitutions, or dose rounding at this time.
